title: Effective-Date and Waiting-Period Figures for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) share one set of waiting-period and term figures across all six tiers.

| Tier | Standard waiting period (calendar days) | Loan-transaction waiting period (calendar days) | Map-revision window (calendar months) | Map-revision waiting period (calendar days) | Policy term (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 30 | 0 | 13 | 1 | 12 |

## What each figure measures

- **Standard waiting period — 30 calendar days.** The wait between the application-and-payment date and coverage attaching, for new business and coverage increases.
- **Loan-transaction waiting period — 0 calendar days.** The wait when coverage is bought or increased in connection with making, increasing, extending or renewing a loan.
- **Map-revision window — 13 calendar months.** The window after a flood map revision that places the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area during which the map-revision exception applies.
- **Map-revision waiting period — 1 calendar day.** The wait under the map-revision exception.
- **Policy term — 12 calendar months.** The length of one policy term.

**Illustration (hypothetical dates).** Under the standard 30-day wait, an application and full premium received on 3 March has coverage attaching at 12:01 a.m. on 2 April, found by adding 30 days to the receipt date on the calendar.

## Parameter meanings

- Waiting period between the application-and-payment date and coverage attaching for new business and coverage increases; calendar days.
- Waiting period when coverage is bought or increased in connection with making, increasing, extending or renewing a loan; calendar days.
- Window after a flood map revision that places the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area during which the map-revision exception applies; calendar months.
- Waiting period under the map-revision exception; calendar days.
- Length of one policy term; calendar months.
